snippet.title: Desktop Snail Assassin - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The idle desktop snails-like. Every now and then the murderous snail assassin is hunting your mouse cursor, turning your desktop into a chaotic bullet hell. How long can you survive?!  

🐌 Procedurally generated snail attacks
🐂 Snuffalo Stampede
💀 Secret Snail Boss Fight in the endgame
🏆 Achievement for getting the global highscore (currently at 1h)

Desktop Snail Assassin on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3894960/Desktop_Snail_Assassin

#bongocat #indiegames #meme #snail #ninja
